originality.rationale: The principal 2022 growing-initial-urn result assumes no random entire-urn restart. The 2011 Brownian reset Laplace law is acknowledged prior art; the finite regenerative reinforced-urn joint law, all-lag covariance and combined Gaussian/normal-mixture/Laplace crossover are not included in these inspected primary statements. Scientific comparisons with inspected primary literature and publicly indexed findings found no covering claim. The possibility of broader unindexed regeneration theorems remains an explicit risk.

The exact invariant and temporal covariance, nontrivial crossover scale at r of order 1/n, critical Gaussian variance mixture and stationary reset-diffusion path limit jointly clarify how reinforcement memory is limited by exogenous restart; not a parameter substitution into an unreset urn model.
